questions.stem: In a certain code language, 'ROAD' is written as 'ADOR'. How is 'SWAN' be written in the same code?
questions.solution:
Letters of the given word are arranged in alphabetical order in its code.

Therefore, the code for SWAN is ANSW.

questions.stem:
The given bar graph shows how 209 people travel to work.

![figure](asset:q14-stem-fig)

How many people travel by car ?
questions.solution:
Total number of people = 209

Number of people travel by Motorcycle = 22

Number of people travel by Bus = 55

Number of people travel by Taxi = 44

So, number of people travel by car = 209 – (22 + 55 + 44)

= 209 – 121 = 88

questions.stem: Mr Gupta travelled 35 km 800 m by car and 18 km 40 m by air. What distance did he travel in all ?
questions.solution:
Distance travelled by car = 35 km 800 m

Distance travelled by air = 18 km 40 m

Therefore, total distance travelled = 35 km 800 m + 18 km 40 m

= 53 km 840 m

questions.stem: Which of the following numbers has the least number of factors?
questions.solution:
A. Factors of 35 are 1, 5, 7 and 35.

B. Factors of 28 are 1, 2, 4, 7, 14 and 28.

C. Factors of 48 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 48. D. Factors of 16 are 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16.

Hence, 35 has the least number of factors.

questions.stem:

![figure](asset:q20-stem-fig)
questions.solution:
Place value of the digit in ten thousands place in 73569 = 70000

Place value of the digit in hundreds place in 73569 = 500 Therefore, required difference = 70000 – 500 = 69500

questions.stem: ![There were 21 people in a room. 2 7 of them were children. How many adults were there?](asset:q21-stem)
questions.solution: ![Total number of people = 21 As, 2 7 of them were children. So, number of children = 2 × 21 = 6 7 Hence, number of adults = 21 – 6 = 15](asset:q21-sol)

questions.stem: Sneha is 11 years 7 months old. Her sister is 3 years 8 months older than her. What is the sum of their ages?
questions.solution: ![Age of Sneha = 11 years 7 months Her sister is 3 years 8 months older than her. Therefore, age of her sister = 11 years 7 months + 3 years 8 months = 14 years 15 months i.e., 15 years 3 months Hence, sum of their ages = 11 years 7 months + 15 years 3 months = 26 years 10 months](asset:q22-sol)

questions.stem: There are 69 rows of trees in a land. Each row has 47 trees. What is the total number of trees in the land?
questions.solution:
Number of trees in 1 row = 47

Number of rows = 69

So, number of trees in 69 rows = 47 × 69 = 3243

questions.stem: The total length of 2 pieces of ribbon is 220 cm. If the length of one piece of ribbon is 180 cm longer than the other, then find the length of the longer piece.
questions.solution: ![We have, length of longer piece = length of shorter piece + 180 cm But, total length = 220 cm Therefore, length of longer piece + length of shorter piece = 220 cm or, length of shorter piece + length of shorter piece + 180 = 220 cm or, 2 length of shorter piece = 220 – 180 = 40 cm or, length of shorter piece = 40 2 = 20 cm And length of longer piece = 20 + 180 cm = 200 cm](asset:q24-sol)

questions.stem: Mohit earns ₹ 5503 in a month. Every month, he spends ₹ 2186 and saves the rest. How much will he save in 2 years?
questions.solution:
Monthly income of Mohit = ₹ 5503

Amount of money spent by him in 1 month = ₹ 2186 So, amount of money saved by him in 1 month

= ₹ (5503 – 2186) = ₹ 3317

Since, 2 years = 24 months

Amount of money saved by him in 2 years *i.e.*, 24 months = ₹ (3317 × 24) = ₹ 79608

questions.stem: To boil the eggs hard you must cook them on gas for 16 minutes. If Neeta puts the eggs to boil at 12:36 p.m., then at what time she must switch off the gas?
questions.solution:
Neeta puts the eggs to boil at 12 : 36 p.m. Time taken to boil the eggs is 16 mins.

As, 16 mins after 12 : 36 p.m. is 12:52 p.m. So, she must switch off the gas at 12 : 52 p.m.

questions.stem: Dinesh has 5 boxes of sweets. Each box contains 182 sweets. He packs them equally into some bags. Each bag contains 7 sweets. How many bags does he use?
questions.solution: ![Number of sweets in 1 box = 182 Number of sweets in 5 boxes = 182 × 5 = 910 Now, Dinesh packs 910 sweets equally into bags of 7 sweets each. So, number of bags = 910 = 130 7](asset:q27-sol)

questions.stem: Harsh had 80 kg 150 g of rice. He packed the rice into 12 packets, each weighing 4 kg 500 g. How much rice was left unpacked?
questions.solution:
Total quantity of rice = 80 kg 150 g

Quantity of rice in 1 packet = 4 kg 500 g = 4500 g Total number of packets = 12

So, quantity of rice in 12 packets = (4500 × 12)

= 54000 g = 54 kg Quantity of rice left unpacked = 80 kg 150 g – 54 kg

= 26 kg 150 g

questions.stem:
Rajni bought a story book worth ₹ 2483 and two drawing books worth ₹ 1926 each. Find the total amount of money paid by her when rounded to the nearest tens.

![figure](asset:q30-stem-fig)
questions.solution:
Cost of a story book = ₹ 2483

Cost of a drawing book = ₹ 1926

So, cost of 2 drawing books = ₹ (2 × 1926) = ₹ 3852 Hence, total amount of money paid = ₹ (2483 + 3852) = ₹ 6335 So, estimated total amount of money = ₹ 6340

questions.stem:
Which is the heaviest bird?

![figure](asset:q33-stem-fig)
questions.solution:
We have, P + Q = 55 kg and P + Q + R = 60 kg

So, 55 kg + R = 60 kg

or, R = (60 – 55) kg = 5 kg

Also, P + R = 45 kg

So, P + 5 kg = 45 kg

or, P = (45 – 5) kg = 40 kg

Again, P + Q = 55 kg

So, 40 kg + Q = 55 kg

or, Q = (55 – 40) kg = 15 kg

Hence, the bird P is the heaviest.

questions.stem: Sanjay is thinking of a 5-digit even number PQRST. P is 3 more than the smallest odd number. Q is a common factor of 2 and 11. R is the product of the first 2 digits. The sum of S and T is 9. T is a multiple of 3. What is the number Sanjay is thinking of?
questions.solution:
The smallest odd number is 1.

P is 3 more than smallest odd number. So, P = 3 + 1 = 4

Factors of 2 are 1 and 2.

Factors of 11 are 1 and 11.

Therefore, common factor of 2 and 11 is 1. So, Q = 1

R is product of first two digits.

Therefore, R = 4 × 1 = 4

The sum of S and T is 9.

and T is a multiple of 3.

So, T = 3, 6 or 9

Since, Sanjay is thinking of an even number. So, T = 6

As, sum of S and T is 9.

Then, S = 9 – 6 = 3

Hence, required number = 41436
